# BCM Incident Module Migration Script # Migrates data from old bcm_incident + bcm_incident_management to unified bcm_incident
import logging _logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
def migrate_incident_data(): """Migrate incident data from old structure to unified structure""" try: # Check if old tables exist env.cr.execute(""" SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'bcm_incident_old' ); """) old_incident_exists = env.cr.fetchone()[0]
env.cr.execute(""" SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'bcm_incident_management' ); """) old_management_exists = env.cr.fetchone()[0]
_logger.info(f"Migration check: bcm_incident_old={old_incident_exists}, bcm_incident_management={old_management_exists}")
if not (old_incident_exists or old_management_exists): _logger.info("No old incident tables found, skipping migration") return
# Migrate basic incident data if old_incident_exists: env.cr.execute(""" INSERT INTO bcm_incident ( name, incident_number, description, incident_type, severity, status, create_date, write_date, create_uid, write_uid, company_id, active ) SELECT name, incident_number, description, incident_type, severity, status, create_date, write_date, create_uid, write_uid, COALESCE(company_id, 1), COALESCE(active, true) FROM bcm_incident_old WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bcm_incident WHERE bcm_incident.incident_number = bcm_incident_old.incident_number ); """) migrated_count = env.cr.rowcount _logger.info(f"Migrated {migrated_count} basic incident records")
# Migrate incident management data if old_management_exists: env.cr.execute(""" UPDATE bcm_incident SET response_team_activated = COALESCE(im.response_team_activated, false), escalation_level = COALESCE(im.escalation_level, 1), communication_plan = im.communication_plan, stakeholder_notification = COALESCE(im.stakeholder_notification, false) FROM bcm_incident_management im WHERE bcm_incident.incident_number = im.incident_number; """) updated_count = env.cr.rowcount _logger.info(f"Updated {updated_count} incidents with management data")
# Set default values for new fields env.cr.execute(""" UPDATE bcm_incident SET ai_classification_confidence = 75.0, ai_risk_score = 50.0, digital_twin_sync = false WHERE ai_classification_confidence IS NULL OR ai_risk_score IS NULL OR digital_twin_sync IS NULL; """)
_logger.info("BCM Incident migration completed successfully")
except Exception as e: _logger.error(f"Migration failed: {str(e)}") raise
# Execute migration migrate_incident_data()
